data.body: Pushed Gerrit change 3476 (patch set 1, 01e0dcfa3e1, rebased on origin/main 2ca3e28fcc6). Main's 2ca3e28fcc6 goose fail-closed tests were adapted to set REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH plus a separate authorship key; the too-permissive authorship case skips on Windows per cloistered-decomposed-nymph. make verify (9h46m on a load ~37 host) caught one of mine (broad except flagged by test_tombstone_registry; fixed by validating the authorship key before composing the signer). On the rebased tree my modules, typecheck and lint pass; 7 unrelated tests still fail (incl. known-red test_reclaim_resign), comparison against origin/main running.
